title: An act's motion trace (timing/motion/actN.json)
description: Every traced move of one act, written by the engine that built it (the kit's defineMotion registry through `slate emit-events` and `slate render`, the open web renderer, or `slate ae acts export`), and read by `slate qa motion`. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §12 is the contract: each entry names its move, the property it moves, the ease, its film frames and its values, with samples at whole frames. An act with no moves (a placeholder, a still) writes an empty list. The optional keys tell the motion gate what moves and what it may do: class (rig, ui, carry or whip, which speed limits apply), exempt with its reason, exception (a break a person signs off), size and unit.

shot.description: the shot the move starts in (null when an engine couldn't place it)

ease.description: a brand ease, a kit curve (linear, sine, spring0, even), or measured (sampled in After Effects)
